purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical billing. It handles inpatient (nyuin) master update processing, specifically managing hospitalization-related medical act records, insurance combinations, and billing calculations. It is invoked from screen K08 and processes admission/discharge medical procedure data.

verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text comments encoded in a multi-byte encoding (likely EUC-JP) that was decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt (rezept) software ORCA developed by JMA. Copyright notice confirms 2002 JMA origin. The COPY statements reference many domain-specific copybooks not shown in the truncated source.
